name: Misal Pav
instructions: 1. Boil the moth bean sprouts with turmeric and salt until tender.
2. Prepare a base masala by sautéing mustard seeds, curry leaves, onions, ginger-garlic paste, and tomatoes in oil.
3. Add goda masala, chili powder, and turmeric, then mix in the boiled sprouts.
4. Add water to adjust the consistency to create the 'kat' (the spicy, oily gravy layer) and simmer.
5. Serve in a bowl, layering the sprouts first, then topping with farsan, chopped onions, and coriander.
6. Serve hot with toasted pav, lemon wedges, and extra gravy on the side.
description: Misal Pav is a legendary Maharashtrian breakfast dish known for its intense heat and complex flavor profile. It is a staple street food that represents the vibrant culinary heritage of the region, specifically popular in Pune, Nashik, and Mumbai.
